title: Spank: Slap your MacBook, it yells back. Uses Apple Silicon accelerometer via IOKit HID
description:
Ever been so frustrated debugging that you wanted to smack your MacBook? Now it will actually respond! Spank uses the built-in accelerometer on Apple Silicon Macs to detect when you physically slap your laptop and plays sound effects in response. Three modes: 'pain' (Mac yells "ow!"), 'Halo' (Halo death sound), and 'sexy' (intensity increases with repeated hits over five minutes). completely useless, guaranteed to get a laugh. Just don't break your screen.

https://github.com/taigrr/spank
